description: Frame body length boundary test vectors per spec/02-physical-link.md section 4.1. Length byte specifies frame body length excluding itself, valid range 4-254 bytes. Tests minimum, maximum, and invalid boundaries.
oracle_provenance: Independent calculation from spec: Length byte = total_frame_bytes - 1. Frame body = LLSec(1) + Epoch(1) + SeqNum(2) + DstAddr(0/2/8) + Payload(var) + MIC(0/48). Minimum unsigned broadcast = 1+1+2+0+0+0 = 4 bytes.

vectors.name: body_length_3_underflow
vectors.description: Frame body length 3 is below minimum (spec requires 4-254). Missing SeqNum high byte.

expected.reason: Body length 3 below minimum 4 bytes (LLSec+Epoch+SeqNum = 4 bytes minimum)

vectors.name: body_length_4_minimum_valid
vectors.description: Frame body length 4 is the minimum valid size: LLSec(1) + Epoch(1) + SeqNum(2) = 4 bytes.
vectors.notes: Broadcast with no payload and no signature - minimal control frame

vectors.name: body_length_254_maximum_valid
vectors.description: Frame body length 254 is the maximum valid size per spec.
vectors.notes: 250 bytes of 0xAA payload (254 - 4 byte fixed header)

vectors.name: body_length_255_exceeds_limit
vectors.description: Frame body length 255 exceeds maximum (spec allows 4-254 only).

expected.reason: Length 255 exceeds maximum 254 per spec section 4.1

vectors.name: body_length_2_severely_truncated
vectors.description: Frame body length 2 is severely truncated (missing Epoch and SeqNum).

expected.reason: Body length 2 cannot contain minimum header (LLSec+Epoch+SeqNum = 4 bytes)

vectors.name: body_length_1_minimal_truncation
vectors.description: Frame body length 1 only has LLSec byte.

vectors.name: body_length_0_empty_body
vectors.description: Frame body length 0 has no body at all.

vectors.name: body_length_5_with_payload
vectors.description: Frame body length 5: minimum header (4) + 1 byte payload.

vectors.name: body_length_6_with_short_addr
vectors.description: Frame body length 6: header (4) + short addr (2) + no payload.
